scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:moon && pnpm run web:build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:worker && pnpm run test:assets && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.ui:plan: vlmkit-plan --title 'Authority Item Verification Smoke' --request-file specs/authority-item-verification.request.md --observations specs/authority-item-verification.observations.json --out specs/authority-item-verification.plan.md --structured-out specs/authority-item-verification.plan.json --locator-inventory-out specs/authority-item-verification.locators.json --scope smoke --max-attempts 3
scripts.ui:lineage-plan: vlmkit-plan --title 'Lineage Settlement Status Recovery' --request-file specs/lineage-settlement-status.request.md --observations specs/lineage-settlement-status.observations.json --out specs/lineage-settlement-status.plan.md --structured-out specs/lineage-settlement-status.plan.json --locator-inventory-out specs/lineage-settlement-status.locators.json --scope smoke --max-attempts 3
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:all && wrangler dev --var ADMIN_TOKEN:test-admin-token --var WITNESS_SOURCE_BUCKET_KEY:test-source-bucket-key-000000000000
scripts.dev:e2e: pnpm run build:all && wrangler dev --port 8792 --var ADMIN_TOKEN:test-admin-token --var WITNESS_SOURCE_BUCKET_KEY:test-source-bucket-key-000000000000
